slice: V0-sign: local self-signed HAP (no device, no install)

signing.ca: self-signed local root -> app sub-CA / profile sub-CA -> leaf (3-level chain)
signing.keystore: signing/q207-local.p12 (contains PRIVATE KEYS; git-ignored, local test only)
signing.profile_issuer: pki_internal (local value; NOT an OpenHarmony-issued profile)
signing.store_password_source: Q207_SIGN_STORE_PWD env var or gitignored signing/.local_pwd; never used for a real release

installable_reason: self-signed CA (not in device trust store) + no device UDID for a debug profile; release-type profile signed locally only
blocked: install/verify-with-system-signature not possible: no board/device (no UDID, no hdc target)
HAP signature is anchor-less for a stock device: local self-signed CA is not in the OpenHarmony trusted root store, so a real device would reject the profile/cert chain
next_materials_needed: OpenHarmony-issued app signing cert chain + Provision Profile (release) for the issuer/developer-id used by the target device image
OR a debug profile signed by the official debug CA with this device's UDID (hdc shell bm get -u) to install a debug HAP
a target board/flash image to run 'hdc install' and verify on-device acceptance
notes: Signed HAP is signature-verifiable locally (verify-app exit 0) but is NOT installed and NOT claimed installable. No device was touched. Private key material stays in signing/ and is git-ignored.
